name: 93505 · Calif City, CA
findings: ZIP 93505 (Calif City) has 39 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 93505 (Calif City) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 93505 (Calif City) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 57% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
